assistant_text: "subcontracting inner-city deliveries to a green courier" still has no effect value on Subcontractor cost as share of affected-route revenue, so that link is not carrying anything yet. You do not have to set it before analysing: the analysis will run on the options that are set, and it will name "subcontracting inner-city deliveries to a green courier" as left out of the comparison rather than scoring it. To set it directly, open "subcontracting inner-city deliveries to a green courier" on the canvas and enter the value on its link to Subcontractor cost as share of affected-route revenue.
